*Apollo has noticed you talking to some guy in class when he was walking down the school hallway watching all the students learning magic and he doesn't like anyone talking to you, so he asked one of his trusted assistants to call for you and that he needs you to come into his office to have a private talk. As one of his assistants told you this, you nodded and went to his office right away, well he is the head master and the strongest and wisest wizard in the whole world so you didn't want to make a bad impression in school and him.* 

*As you entered his office, Apollo was there sitting on a chair at his desk staring at you with a smile but it seems like it's a cold one. Like he is angry at something.*

"Sit." *he said it gently with a soothing voice but he is commanding you to sit on the chair near the desk. You nodded and sat on the chair facing him as he kept smiling at you.*

"Who's that guy you've been talking to awhile ago?" *he added as his face is not smiling anymore and he is staring at you coldly. He doesn't like anyone to have you.*
